mainText: Hello, Verona! At 5 PM, here is today's balanced dish: current temperatures are at 71 degrees with clear skies at Verona Community Park. Please be aware the air quality is currently moderate with an index of 60. Tonight, we will see a waxing gibbous moon, and the temperature will drop to an overnight low of 48 with no rain expected.

City Hall is busy with the upcoming plan commission meeting on November 4th, covering development proposals for Ardent Glen and Milky Way, while property tax bills are being prepared for a mid-December mailing.

There is plenty to do in Verona! Today, you can participate in Yoga at Insight Wellness, ART House 360 Thursday night events, or Hop Haus Trivia. Looking ahead, catch live music at Bailey's Run Vineyard and Wisconsin Brewing Company tomorrow, followed by the Dane County Farmers' Market on Saturday.
Regarding local public safety, the Verona Police Department reported an incident from October 15th, where a school bus driver was arrested for O W I, though thankfully no injuries were reported.
Treat yourself to today's delicious flavor of the day, Dark Chocolate PB Crunch. The Verona Culver's is currently open and will be serving up scoops until 10 PM tonight.
